verdict.rationale: Daily is a developer video/voice platform, and an in-product AI assistant (for example in its dashboard or docs) is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Pipecat, a framework developers use to build and deploy their own voice AI agents, plus llms.txt and OpenAPI files for external tools. These are developer building blocks, not a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
